items.description: Agent grant forms (AGENTIDXFORM-01, GRANTFORMGAP-01, REVIEWSUGG-01 agents part; see `.planning/BACKLOG.md`). (a) AGENTIDXFORM-01: give the in-memory agents-index row a type whose shape carries the grant-form invariant (an implementation always comes with its stored form; the active key is present), WITHOUT changing the saved `agents-index.json` format (`persistence/agents-index-schema.ts` stays the on-disk schema, `schemaVersion` 1); for example parse the optional `mcpImplementation`/`mcpForms` pair into one discriminated value at the read seam and drop the run-time guards in `bridges/agents/grant-rewrite.ts` that the type now proves. If no shape fits without a file-format change, record why and leave it. (b) REVIEWSUGG-01: `mcpServerNames` and `mcpGrantForms` in `StageAgentsInput` (`bridges/agents/types.ts`, `bridges/agents/grant-forms.ts`) are coupled by convention; tie them in the type or record why not. (c) REVIEWSUGG-01: `isRewritable` in `grant-rewrite.ts` swallows a read or containment error with no trace; add an `mcp`-channel `hookDebugLog` line (the load stays silent to the user, RECON-05). (d) GRANTFORMGAP-01, decided: keep the current behavior. When an agent's explicit `tools:` maps to nothing under the inactive implementation, the row keeps no form for it and a switch leaves the file and row untouched; pi-subagents 0.84.0 refuses to launch such an agent with an error naming the unresolved `mcp:` selectors under both implementations, and list/info already mark the plugin. Add a unit test in `test/bridges/agents/` pinning that a switch leaves that row and file untouched, and update the comment in `grant-forms.ts` (point 3) to say why. Do not edit `.planning/BACKLOG.md`; report each disposition in the SUMMARY.

Recorded MCP servers (LEGACYSRC-01 and REVIEWSUGG-01 `RecordedMcpServers` part; see `.planning/BACKLOG.md`). In `orchestrators/mcp/recorded-servers.ts`: build a `LegacyServersSource` through one constructor that takes the scope, the marketplace record, and the plugin name, so `marketplaceName`, the plugin name, and the scope locations cannot disagree with the record the containment check (UF-1, NFR-10) trusts; give `LegacyServersUnreadableError` a neutral name, since stored servers use it too (keep `instanceof` narrowing, never message matching). In `domain/mcp-implementation.ts`, `RecordedMcpServers` merges `recorded` and `re-resolved` and drops the unreadable reason: keep the arms distinct where a consumer needs them and carry the reason on the unreadable arm, or record why a consumer never needs it. Trace every caller first (codegraph or `fallow dead-code --type-aware --symbol-impact`). No change to `state.json`. Do not edit `.planning/BACKLOG.md`; report each disposition in the SUMMARY.

MCP status lookup (STATUSLOOKUP-01 and REVIEWSUGG-01 status part; see `.planning/BACKLOG.md`). Make `McpStatusLookup` (`platform/mcp-status.ts`) a discriminated union with one arm per MCP implementation, where `projectTrusted` and `cwd` exist only on the built-in arm, built by a single function that picks the reader from `McpStatusReaders`; update `orchestrators/plugin/info.ts` (around line 3347) and `orchestrators/plugin/info-mcp-status.ts`. Also from REVIEWSUGG-01: the built-in status lookup is unguarded (a throw from Pi's registry or tool list reaches `info`); guard it so `info` still renders, and decide what token a failed read shows, using the existing closed set only (no new token or message kind); and a server whose built-in config is `undefined` reads a bare `not loaded`: check whether that is reachable and either give it the right existing token or record why it cannot happen. A user-visible `info` change ships an `@builtin-only` cucumber scenario under `features/mcp-server/` that fails without it. Do not edit `.planning/BACKLOG.md`; report each disposition in the SUMMARY.

Hooks tool view (HOOKTOOLREAD-01 and REVIEWSUGG-01 hooks part; see `.planning/BACKLOG.md`). In `bridges/hooks/mcp-tool-view.ts`: when `pi.getAllTools()` throws, do not cache the failed probe's answer for the bridge generation (the next event retries), and write one `mcp`-channel `hookDebugLog` line per generation for the failure; nothing reaches the user. `HookTool.name` is derivable from its identity: derive it or record why not. The literal `builtin:mcp` is defined in both `platform/pi-api.ts` (around line 324) and `mcp-tool-view.ts:30`: keep one definition in the lower layer, respecting the fallow boundary zones (`.fallowrc.json`). Unit tests in `test/bridges/hooks/` cover the retry and the single log line. Do not edit `.planning/BACKLOG.md`; report each disposition in the SUMMARY.

Import warning cause (IMPORTCAUSE-01; see `.planning/BACKLOG.md`). An import whose plugin is not installable reports a warning `cause` of `Plugin "<name>" is not installable: \n\ncause: Plugin "<name>" is not installable: ` (the not-installable message repeated with an empty reason list). Find where the import orchestrator (`orchestrators/import/`) builds the cause, and build it once from the narrowed reasons, as install does (`orchestrators/plugin/install.messaging.ts` around line 371, `shared/errors.ts` around line 1245). Match what Claude Code's `/plugin` import of a Claude config reports for a plugin it cannot install where the upstream contract is known (`.agents/skills/claude-code-compat-research`); otherwise match this extension's install wording. Update the pinned text in `test/orchestrators/import/execute.test.ts`, and ship a cucumber scenario under `features/` that shows the corrected warning and fails without the fix. Do not edit `.planning/BACKLOG.md`; report the disposition in the SUMMARY.

Built-in registration error handling (REVIEWSUGG-01 error-handling part; see `.planning/BACKLOG.md`). In `orchestrators/mcp/builtin-registration-step.ts` and `bridges/mcp/builtin-registration.ts`: (a) two plugin servers whose names fold to the same built-in name (`-` vs `_`) overwrite each other silently; detect the collision and keep one deterministically (declaration order), with an `mcp`-channel debug line for the other, and check what `info` shows for the dropped one (existing closed-set token only); (b) a failed unregister only debug-logs: confirm the load must stay silent (RECON-05) and that the next sync retries, or fix; (c) name owners are noted before the sync: confirm a failed sync cannot leave a stale owner that later misreports `info`, or fix. In `bridges/mcp/builtin-overrides.ts` and `bridges/mcp/builtin-description.ts`: a read or parse failure is swallowed without a trace; add one `mcp`-channel debug line each, keeping the no-throw contract (T-02-18). Anything user-visible ships an `@builtin-only` cucumber scenario. Do not edit `.planning/BACKLOG.md`; report each disposition in the SUMMARY.

MCP domain and soft-dependency types (REVIEWSUGG-01 types part; see `.planning/BACKLOG.md`). Triage each, fix where it tightens the type without a saved-format change, otherwise record why not: `McpDependency.runEvery` (`shared/concerns/soft-dep.ts`) is an array that encodes four states; `toolNamePrefix` (`domain/mcp-implementation.ts:42`) returns `string | undefined` though the adapter always returns one; declaration order kept in a `Record` reorders integer-like server names (find the sites; Claude Code keeps `mcpServers` in JSON object order too, so check parity before changing); `SoftDepStatus` fields (`platform/pi-api.ts:170`) are mutable; the `"none"` implementation can be read as the adapter by a new consumer (make the fallback explicit at each read); `mcpBundle` in `persistence/state-io.ts:162` is `Type.Optional(Type.Literal(true))` (a saved `state.json` field: do not change its on-disk form). Also: the soft-dependency probe swallows a read error without a trace; add an `mcp`-channel debug line. Trace callers before each change. Do not edit `.planning/BACKLOG.md`; report each disposition in the SUMMARY.

MCP implementation test gaps (REVIEWSUGG-01 tests part; see `.planning/BACKLOG.md`). Add unit cases for the `none` MCP implementation at `apply`'s toggle and deferred-enable sites and in convergence (`orchestrators/reconcile/apply.ts`, `orchestrators/reconcile/convergence.ts`, their tests under `test/orchestrators/reconcile/`). Add cucumber scenarios that show the split `runEvery` marker (each implementation runs only some of a plugin's servers) and the `none` implementation for `update`, `reinstall`, and tab completion, following the `cucumber` skill (one scenario per behavior, profile tags as the existing `features/mcp-server/` scenarios use). Tests only; if a test exposes a defect, fix it in the same task and say so in the SUMMARY. Do not edit `.planning/BACKLOG.md`.
